slice: Recover and harden the actual Werkles need-translation, not-match, solution-routing, reciprocity, and formation architecture before more Recommendations UI is treated as product intelligence.
sharedContext: The exact original artifact was recovered: company/WERKLES_MATCH_STACKING_AND_NEED_TRANSLATION_V0.md. Werkles asks what structure helps the member move forward before asking who matches them.
The deterministic code already runs signals -> leverage -> Layer 0 -> not-match -> path scoring -> explainable readout. It is rules-only, not an LLM and not a probability model.
The recovered five layers after Layer 0 are hard eligibility, anti-gaming/quality, compatibility, two-sided preference, and cohort/crew formation.
A valid output may be proof, a reversible test, equipment, supplier, training, professional help, capital preparation, a person, a crew, or pause/no-match.
Current member UI re-scores saved signals, but its strongest plans come from a few hand-authored scenario branches. The generic fallback is shallow. This is the bypass under review.

Current Ghost Fleet person ranking is synthetic/local and scores capital complementarity, offer-to-blocker overlap, reciprocity, situation, geography, and credential coverage. It is not production five-layer matching.
No SQL, provider, LLM, push, deploy, production data, or public flag action is in scope.
liveStrings: Generic fallback: 'Turn the next move into evidence.'
